prompt: The program generates the same dice roll every execution. Why?
choices: nextInt(6) always returns the same value
The seed 1234 is fixed — the same seed always produces the same sequence
new Random() requires the current time to work
nextInt(6) is not the correct way to simulate a die
explanation: A fixed seed gives a deterministic sequence. new Random(1234) always starts the PRNG in the same state. For random results each run, use new Random() (no seed) — it uses a time-based seed by default.
